challenge.prompt: Create a polished side-scrolling 2D platformer on Canvas in the style of the 16-bit classics, with an original hero (not an existing character) drawn with code as colorful pixel art. The level scrolls horizontally and is at least 6 screens long, with ground, floating platforms, gaps to jump, moving platforms, coins to collect, enemies that walk back and forth (the hero defeats them by jumping on them) and a goal flag at the end. Include parallax background layers (sky, clouds, hills), a coin counter and a score, simple particle effects when collecting coins or defeating enemies, and a win screen when the flag is reached. Controls: Arrow Left/Right to move, Space or Arrow Up to jump, R to restart. No external assets. Vanilla JS.

rubric.es: Hay un héroe dibujado en pixel art, reconocible como personaje
Hay un nivel de plataformas: suelo, plataformas flotantes y huecos para saltar
El nivel avanza en horizontal (el escenario cambia entre capturas, no es siempre la misma pantalla)
Hay monedas para recoger y un contador de monedas o puntos que sube
Hay fondo con capas (cielo, nubes, colinas)
El personaje se mueve y juega solo (cambia de posición y salta entre capturas)
El juego se ve grande y cuidado, no un recuadro pequeño en una esquina
Va fluido (al menos 30 fotogramas por segundo)

prompt:
Create a polished side-scrolling 2D platformer on Canvas in the style of the 16-bit classics, with an original hero (not an existing character) drawn with code as colorful pixel art. The level scrolls horizontally and is at least 6 screens long, with ground, floating platforms, gaps to jump, moving platforms, coins to collect, enemies that walk back and forth (the hero defeats them by jumping on them) and a goal flag at the end. Include parallax background layers (sky, clouds, hills), a coin counter and a score, simple particle effects when collecting coins or defeating enemies, and a win screen when the flag is reached. Controls: Arrow Left/Right to move, Space or Arrow Up to jump, R to restart. No external assets. Vanilla JS.

Also include an autoplay demo mode toggled with the P key, in which the game plays itself competently (an AI controls the player) so a viewer can watch a good run.

Requirements: deliver everything in ONE self-contained HTML file (inline CSS and JavaScript; no external resources, CDNs, fonts or images). Reply with the complete file in a single ```html code block.

faults: El área de juego es un pequeño recuadro centrado, no ocupa la pantalla completa.
La resolución del pixel art es muy baja (los sprites son diminutos y difíciles de distinguir en detalle).
El lienzo de juego es extremadamente pequeño respecto al espacio disponible, haciendo difícil distinguir los detalles.
El parallax no parece funcionar visiblemente (el fondo se mantiene estático entre capturas).
